stem: What is the most likely explanation for white-tailed deer having a seasonal breeding cycle instead of a monthly breeding cycle like many domesticated animals?

options.label: F
options.text: Male and female deer come into contact with each other only in the fall.

options.label: G
options.text: Large predators are not found in deer habitats during the spring and summer months.

options.label: H
options.text: Giving birth only in the spring and summer ensures that offspring are born when food is most available.

options.label: J
options.text: Deer give birth in the spring and summer in order to avoid being pregnant during the hot summer months.

visual_elements: Deer Reproductive Cycle timeline showing: Deer breeding season from August to November; Female deer reproductive cycle from November to February; Birth of offspring in May and June
